messages:
ashwin: Heads up — Product is planning a temporary quota bump for Pro during the April promo window (approx 2x per-user rate limits, 50% higher burst quota). They want confirmation we can absorb it next Monday. Tagging @maria for capacity numbers. PLANS: 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-26. Any immediate red flags?

maria: Quick read — baseline avg GPU hours = 120000/mo across fleet. Naive demand scaling for 2x rate limits + promo adoption -> estimated +20-30% GPU-hours, but concentrated: evenings PST and EU business hours. EU pool is tight (only ~40 GPUs reserved for inference). Roughs: +24k GPU-hrs/mo (~20%) with current routing. That translates to ~+$11.8k/mo if we add reserved nodes (4x midgrade) or ~$17k/mo on on-demand. Need to decide reserve vs burst.

zoe: Mitigations we should try before provisioning: 1) enforce per-customer burst cap at routing layer (e.g., 150 tokens/sec), 2) canary heavy models to quantized variant (13B-int8) for Pro during window, 3) enable more aggressive prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts. If we do these, I estimate residual increase ~8-12%.

kai: Can run a focused load test. Proposed plan: canary -> 20% of Pro traffic in EU for 48h, ramp 0->20% over 2h. Test job:
```
./bench/run_load --profile=pro-heavy --region=eu-west-1 --concurrency=400 --duration=2h
```
We'll capture p95 latency, GPU util, and cache hit rates. Need someone to reserve 4 GPUs in eu-west-1 for the window.

ops-bot: runbook-check: seasonal-quota-bump (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/seasonal-quota-bump) — config sanity checks pending, scheduled check in 30m.

maria: Agree with canary + mitigations path. I'll ask Product to shift rollout to Mon 17:00 UTC so we get overlap with both EU/W US peaks. I'll also request reservation: 4x A10-class GPUs in eu-west-1 for 2 weeks, and enable fallback to 13B-int8 variant for Pro via model-routing policy. I'll post the cost delta once reservations confirmed.

ashwin: Cost question — if we reserve 4 GPUs for two weeks what is the pro-rated delta? Also, how reversible is the routing change if we see quality regressions?

maria: Rough pro-rate: 4 GPUs reserved for 14 days ≈ 4 * 24 * 14 = 1344 GPU-hrs. With our A10 baseline ~$8.75/GPU-hr equivalent -> ~$11,760 pro-rated. Routing change reversible instantly (policy toggles via console). Quality guard: enable automatic rollback if eval drift > 1.5% on eval set.

zoe: Config snippet for burst cap (routing layer):
```
route.pro.rate_limit = { tokens_per_sec: 150, burst_tokens: 500 }
route.pro.fallback_variant = '13b-int8'
```
We'll need a quick feature flag to flip this for the promo.

kai: I'll schedule the load test Mon 16:00 UTC to pre-warm nodes and then run canary at 17:00. Who owns reservations? @maria?

maria: I'll submit the reservation request now and ping infra procurement. Posting ETA in ~15m. :thumbsup:

ashwin: Sounds good. Please post results of the 48h canary in #eng-infra with p95, gpu_util, cache_hit, and cost delta. If we can keep extra hours <10% we can avoid reserves. Thanks.
